conclusion: The candidate generator must be the semantic IR, not the pattern ruleset. The ruleset would cap recall at 12.1%, well below the 64.9% the unconstrained loop already reaches; the IR caps it at 96.6% and hands the model a median of ten sites to judge instead of a repository to search.
note: A candidate-driven detector can only judge sites something else enumerates, so the enumerator sets a hard ceiling on recall. Measured over the 58 scorable vendored web pairs, before building anything.
